news.title: Analysis: The U.S. is running out of ways to get oil prices down. It is up to the military.
news.description: Iran's threat to the Strait of Hormuz can't be fixed by releasing oil from strategic petroleum reserves.

news.title: Pete Hegseth on Strait of Hormuz: 'Don't need to worry about it'
news.description: The Strait of Hormuz, the world's most critical chokepoint for oil shipments, has been effectively closed since the U.S. and Israel began the war on Iran.

news.title: Trump says he thinks Putin is helping Iran
news.description: Russian leaders told President Trump they aren't sharing intelligence with Iran as it fights the U.S. and Israel, special envoy Steve Witkoff said this week.
